name: 書式付きメッセージの転送編集
prompt:
Correct the v001 image to match the native 390×880 component preview. Keep the Japanese transfer screen, every word, the blue 動画の資料 link, controls and toolbar.

Fix the main structural error first: the forwarded-post card border must surround the entire shared post, from the author row through the attribution. In v001, the border stops after the quote and leaves the code heading, mint code block, member row and attribution outside. Put the quote, code heading, code block, member names and attribution inside the same outer card, as in the preview. The native frame is x=16, y=168, width=358, height=610 on the 390×880 canvas; its lower edge is y=778. Keep the post content inside that border. The top controls occupy y=8–32, the channel chip y=58–90, the composer line y=112–136, and the formatting toolbar frame y=806–864.

Match the native preview typography and compact spacing instead of enlarging labels. Use the Meiryo sizes and line heights already established by the native node. Align the quote, code and footer with the preview. Keep the full-color green avatar, mint channel chip and code panel, green member names and code heading, gray attribution, thin neutral outline and gray toolbar controls. Only the actual embedded hyperlink 動画の資料 is blue #1976D2 without underline; Cancel, Send, the toolbar control リンク and every other label retain their original colors. Preserve exact Japanese wording and punctuation, including <メモ>一緒に進めましょう。</メモ>. Do not show the English source text or keyboard, add any controls or decoration, or invent a hyperlink destination.
reviewNotes: v002 is the final attempt at 390x880. The full shared post, quote, code heading/panel, members and attribution now sit inside the outer card; only 動画の資料 is blue #1976D2, while Cancel/Send and toolbar リンク remain controls. The text still reads larger with expanded gaps than native, and the literal code line has a visible extra gap before </メモ>. Keep needs-correction after two attempts. Full raw ImageGen frame path and SHA-256 are in review-w02-a002.json.
reviewNotice: 画像生成候補。ネイティブ編集・実装・所有者承認とは別です。
